$comment: `base` is the path prefix the site is published under. It MUST be
configurable, because this project publishes at
https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/ rather than at a domain root, and a
static site that hardcodes a root with no base emits absolute URLs for
every asset: the build succeeds, the deployment goes green, and every page
404s. `node site/build.js --verify` checks the emitted output actually
Override at build time with --base, or with the SITE_BASE environment
variable (the Pages workflow sets it from the repository name).
